title: Leisure Time

source.book: Tiếng Anh 8 – Global Success (Sách học sinh)

objectivesVi: Dùng từ về hoạt động giải trí và cách nói thích / không thích.
Phát âm đúng âm /ʊ/ và /uː/ trong từ và câu.
Dùng động từ chỉ sự thích / ghét + V-ing hoặc to V.
Mời bạn và nhận lời mời (thêm: từ chối lịch sự).
Nói về hoạt động giải trí với gia đình và bạn bè.

talks.prompt: Talk about the leisure activities you do with your family.
talks.promptVi: Nói khoảng 30 giây về những hoạt động giải trí bạn làm cùng gia đình.
guide: What leisure activities do you usually do with your family?
Which one do you like the most? Why?
How do you feel when you spend time with your family?
usefulLanguage: The activity I like the most is ...
talks.model: In my free time, my family and I usually go cycling to the villages near our town. We also cook together at the weekend. The activity I like the most is cooking, because we can talk and laugh a lot. Sometimes the food isn't very good, but we still enjoy it. I feel happy and relaxed when I spend time with my family.

talks.prompt: Talk about what you do with your friends in your free time.
talks.promptVi: Nói khoảng 30 giây về những gì bạn làm cùng bạn bè lúc rảnh.
guide: When do you usually have free time?
What do you usually do with your friends?
Why do you do these activities?
talks.model: I usually have free time at the weekend. My friends and I often play badminton in the park, and sometimes we go to the cinema. We play badminton because it keeps us healthy, and it's a lot of fun. When it rains, we stay at home and play board games. I love spending time with my friends because we can relax together.

talks.prompt: Talk about a leisure activity from another country that you want to try.
talks.promptVi: Nói khoảng 30 giây về một hoạt động giải trí ở nước khác mà bạn muốn thử.
guide: Which activity do you want to try?
Why do you want to try it?
Who would you like to do it with?
usefulLanguage: I want to do it with ...
talks.model: I'd like to try origami, the art of paper folding from Japan. It looks easy, but I think it needs a lot of patience. I want to try it because it helps people relax, and I can make flowers, birds, or fans as presents. I'd like to do it with my younger sister, because she loves making things with paper.

roleplays.title: Invite a friend to the cinema
roleplays.goalVi: Bạn rủ Mai đi xem phim cuối tuần, rồi cùng hẹn giờ và chỗ gặp.
roleplays.aiBrief: You are Mai, a friendly 13-year-old Vietnamese student. The learner will invite you to the cinema this weekend. Accept the invitation, then ask what time and where to meet, and ask if another friend, Lan, can join. Use only short, simple sentences with Grade 8 Unit 1 language (leisure activities, likes and dislikes, inviting and accepting). Never ask for personal information.
usefulLanguage: Would you like to go to the cinema with me?
Do you fancy watching a film on Sunday?

turns.partner: Hi! What are you doing this weekend?
samples: Would you like to go to the cinema with me on Sunday?
Do you fancy watching a film this Sunday?

turns.partner: I'd love to. Thanks! What time shall we meet?
Can I ask Lan to join us?
Cool. See you on Sunday. Bye!

roleplays.title: Answer your friend's invitations
roleplays.titleVi: Trả lời lời mời của bạn
roleplays.goalVi: Tom rủ bạn đi chơi. Với mỗi lời mời, bạn tự chọn nhận lời hoặc từ chối lịch sự (có nêu lý do).
roleplays.aiBrief: You are Tom, a friendly 13-year-old student. Invite the learner to some leisure activities one by one (badminton after school, trying your home-made pizza, making paper flowers). The learner may accept or politely decline; respond kindly either way. Use only short, simple sentences with Grade 8 Unit 1 language. Never ask for personal information.
usefulLanguage: Sorry, I can't. I have to ...
I'm afraid I'm busy. Maybe next time.
roleplays.beyondBookNoteVi: SGK chỉ dạy nhận lời mời (trang 12). Cách từ chối lịch sự (Sorry, I can't... / I'm afraid...) là phần thêm để hội thoại tự nhiên hơn — nhờ cô kiểm tra.

turns.partner: Hi! Do you fancy playing badminton in the park after school?
samples: Sorry, I can't. I have to do my homework.
turns.starter: I'd love to. / Sorry, I can't. I have to ...

turns.partner: Okay! And would you like to try my home-made pizza on Sunday?
samples: I'm afraid I'm busy on Sunday. Maybe next time.

turns.partner: By the way, do you like making things with paper?
samples: Yes, I love making paper flowers.
Not really. I prefer playing sport.
turns.starter: Yes, I ... / Not really. I prefer ...
